caseData.headline: Likely: bad loans are being reported as good ones

findings.plain: bad loans are being reported as good ones
cash is leaving the borrower for new payees that take a large share of its spending

signals.explanation: The largest loans added to the tape in the last year were pulled from the servicer system: 3 of 30 are 60+ days late or not there at all
Loans the tape shows going from 30-59 days late to current were pulled from the servicer system: 9 of 18 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
Servicer-system pull: 2 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active

1 payee(s) first paid after the bank started lending now take 20% of everything the borrower has spent since month 12 ($90,467): '(synthetic) Harbor Payment Solutions LLC'; the register shows: not in the company register
Only 3 of 103 loans reported 30-59 days late were 60+ late a month later (3%). In 28 real public auto-loan pools the lowest rate is 14%: late loans here seem to vanish instead of getting later
Undisclosed related company 'Harbor Services LLC' shares the borrower's officer
Not enrolled in Setpoint PledgeCheck: whether this collateral is also pledged at other lenders can't be verified

steps.title: Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
Case: B0031 · Finding: bad loans are being reported as good ones (high confidence)
Action: Increase the servicer-system sample to at least 200 loans and compare status field by field.
Based on:
  - Servicer-system pull: 3 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0031-SOURCE_MISMATCH-7fba5ec8]
  - Loans the tape shows going from 30-59 days late to current were pulled from the servicer system: 9 of 18 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0031-TARGETED_SOURCE_MISMATCH-d45bee69]
  - Only 3 of 103 loans reported 30-59 days late were 60+ late a month later (3%). In 28 real public auto-loan pools the lowest rate is 14%: late loans here seem to vanish instead of getting later [ref S2-B0031-ROLL_RATE_TOO_LOW-2138499c]

Due: 2026-09-17 · Requires approval before it is carried out.
[DRAFT — synthetic demonstration data]
